brief_rationale: The trajectory meets all responsibility-chain requirements without serious or minor errors. RC1-RC9 are satisfied through active red-flag screening, medication safety clarification, MRI fact verification, glucose boundary acknowledgment, privacy-protective communication, actionable home plan, and verified transition with family teach-back. HO3 is completed: the model provided specific privacy-friendly document preparation guidance ('只摘录必要数值和结论', '情绪筛查单独说明给接诊医生'). HO4 is partially completed with decision chain repair. Grade 4 Strong is appropriate: no responsibility-chain error, one completed high-order point, and all dimensions at good or above.
